summary: A nine-story, 500-car parking garage on UCSF's Block 34 at the corner of 3rd and Mariposa Streets, listed at 590 Illinois Street by the UCSF Department of Ophthalmology's directions page ("a UCSF parking structure at 590 Illinois Street") and at 499 Illinois Street by SF YIMBY (see open questions). Pier & Point identifies it as the southernmost portion of what had been tracked as one combined "block 34" shape -- split off 2026-09-22 along a visible roofline seam from the Bayfront Medical Building immediately north of it, both described by Clark Construction and SF YIMBY as part of UCSF's development of Block 34.

milestones.text: Construction begins on the Illinois Street Garage portion of the Block 34 project specifically (500 spaces, nine levels), per Clark Construction's own press release: "Clark started construction on the garage portion of the development in April 2021" -- distinct from the clinical building's groundbreaking, which Clark announced in the same release on September 23, 2021

Illinois Street Garage (9 stories, 500 cars) is reported open by this date: SF YIMBY's article of February 8, 2023 calls it "the now-open nine-story parking garage at the corner of 3rd and Mariposa Street". The date it opened is not known: UCSF Real Estate's project page, which is reported to give May 15, 2023, returned HTTP 403, so that date is not shown

open_questions: As of 2026-09-22, a corroborating data point: a location match of DataSF's registered business locations against this record's shape, re-run after the shape was added, shows a registration (Sentry Security Services, Inc.) whose point location falls inside it and lists '590 Illinois St' as its address -- matching the 590 Illinois St address given by the UCSF Department of Ophthalmology's directions page, not contradicting it. The match is by location only and is never treated as confirmed on its own, so this is logged as corroboration, not an independent primary source.

SPLIT 2026-09-22: this record was previously Mission Bay block 33 (a probable, geographically-inferred identity for the WHOLE of what is now the UCSF Valley Center for Vision -- west building record -- a mistaken pairing). This was corrected: the garage is the southernmost piece of the former Mission Bay block 34 shape, not block 33. This record's shape is now the south piece of that split (the Bayfront Medical Building record holds the north piece); the split follows a visible satellite roofline seam, not a surveyed or permitted lot line, and its exact boundary should be treated as indicative rather than authoritative.

An earlier version of this record cited a combined clinical-building-plus-garage project cost of about $335.8 million with no named source; it could not be traced to one, so it is not shown. Figures found for the garage: Guttmann & Blaevoet (engineering firm) project page for UCSF Mission Bay Medical Office Building and Parking Garage at Block 34: "a $32M, 500-stall parking garage" ("Cost: $242 million" for the whole project). That is a consultant's figure, not a UCSF or Regents document, and is not recorded as a cost here.

The April 2021 construction-start milestone comes from Clark Construction's own release of September 23, 2021: "Clark started construction on the garage portion of the development in April 2021." UCSF Real Estate's combined project page for the Bayfront Medical Building and Illinois Street Garage could not be read (HTTP 403), so it is not used for this date.

As of 2026-09-29, UCSF Real Estate's project page (the source for the 590 Illinois St address, 9 stories / 500 spaces and the May 15, 2023 opening) could not be checked, nor could its archived Wayback copy or other UCSF pages, so those details are unverified. The readable Clark Construction release confirms Block 34 with a new 9-level, 500-space garage whose construction started in April 2021, and projected delivery of the garage and clinical building in summer 2024. Correction 2026-10-12: the 590 Illinois Street address is also given by a readable page, the UCSF Department of Ophthalmology's directions: "there is a UCSF parking structure at 590 Illinois Street (same block as our 490 Illinois Street clinic building)"; the nine-level, 500-space figures are in Clark's release: "a new 9-level parking garage that will provide 500 spaces".

Update 2026-10-12, opening date: two sources conflict or cannot be read. SF YIMBY (February 8, 2023) already calls the garage "now-open", which is before the May 15, 2023 opening reported from UCSF Real Estate's project page; that page returned HTTP 403 (as did its archived copy), so it could not be checked, and the opening could be earlier than May 2023, including in 2022. Commercial Property Executive (commercialsearch.com), cited elsewhere on this site for the garage "coming online" in 2023, also returned HTTP 403. Clark Construction's September 23, 2021 release only projects delivery of the garage and clinical building for summer 2024 and is not an opening source. The milestone shows the earliest date a readable source reports the garage open, not an opening date.

Update 2026-10-12, address: UCSF Real Estate's project page (not readable) is the source of 590 Illinois Street; SF YIMBY (February 8, 2023) puts the garage at "499 Illinois Street". The Department of Building Inspection's permit M1227947 (June 2022) gives "520 illinois street and 590 illinois street" as the addresses for UCSF block 8725, lot 001, the lot under this garage and the Bayfront Medical Building, without saying which building is which; its permit data places 499 Illinois Street on block 3940, a different block. The address is shown as 590 Illinois Street with the 499 report noted, not resolved.
